stem: In paragraphs 5 and 6, which key idea do the details support about why Mission Blue divides the ocean into small areas called "hope spots"?

options.label: F
options.text: These areas are easier to reach by boat.

options.label: G
options.text: These areas have the deepest waters.

options.label: H
options.text: These areas are easier to care for.

options.label: J
options.text: These areas have very few visitors.
